title: Mochizuki Honami — Beyond A Smile〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Memories That Come With The Scent of Candles

rows.Line: Yoisaki Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you, Ms. Mochizuki.
But you didn't really have to also help clean...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. It's a part of my usual routine whenever I come over. Plus, we got everything done faster by splitting the work.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'll gather up the candles we didn't use over here... But what do we do with the rest of the paper cups?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, you can just leave those here.
I use them from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I've finished cleaning up over here too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: All that's left is for you to all give out the candles you made today.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Also, Mochizuki...
Thank you for teaching us how to make them today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, Honami, thank you so much.
I never imagined that I'd be able to make anything like this.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: All I did was teach you the basics. You were the ones who actually picked the fragrances and made the candles.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But this was our first time making them. I think they turned out so well because of you, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
N-No, please!
Ms. Yoisaki, you don't have to...!

rows.Speaker: Nene & Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, while we're on the subject... What should we do with the leftover scented oils?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, it'd be a shame to just toss them. Isn't there some way for us to use them...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You have quite a few options there.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: For example, you can use some on tissues or a handkerchief to add a nice fragrance to them.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, that'd be pretty easy.
I can do that just before I leave to go somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Exactly. Whenever you clean your hands or wipe off some sweat, they'll leave behind a nice, refreshing aroma.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Aroma stones and diffusers also seem to work well, but you can actually achieve a similar effect by simply putting a few drops into a mug of hot water.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow, I had no idea.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: However, it won't work as well as the items designed for that purpose, so the scent likely won't go beyond, say, your desk.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If a mug of hot water works, then it could be nice to use it in a bath...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, of course. With only a few drops, you enjoy a wonderful fragrance as you bathe.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You can even put some in the fabric softener slot on a laundry machine.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, does that also lead to a soothing smell?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, but it also prevents mold from forming.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Eucalyptus, peppermint...and I believe lemon. They all work well as disinfectants and odor eliminators.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I've also heard that you can make bug spray out of them.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Certain fragrances are apparently very effective at repelling bugs.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wow, these have so many different uses...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
They really do.
In that case, we shouldn't have any issues finding something to do with them.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanna try out some of the things we just discussed.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, Honami, you really are incredibly knowledgeable. I mean, you knew all these uses for scented oils off the top of your head.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: N-No, I just happened to know about those things. Looking up this sort of information is sort of a hobby of mine...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: In any case, I'm glad that you're here to teach us, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Again, thank you so much for today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade & Nene
rows.Line: Thank you, Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm happy that I could help!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And please feel free to ask me any questions whenever you like!
